industry.structure: Connectivity semiconductors for AI and cloud racks (PCIe, Ethernet, CXL retimers and related ICs) sit in a concentrated design-win market: a handful of hyperscaler and OEM customers drive volume, while fabless vendors compete on signal integrity, power, and time-to-ramp. Barriers are engineering depth and socket certification, not capital alone.
industry.share_shift: Astera Labs is gaining share as AI server attach rates for high-speed retimers rise; FY2025 revenue more than doubled YoY and Q1 2026 sustained near-doubling. Larger incumbents (Broadcom, Marvell, Microchip-class vendors) and in-house silicon at hyperscalers remain the primary share threats.
